card.name: Dosing schedule and interval wording
card.fires_on: Words and spaces in dosing directions just before a number, interval or schedule term, such as 'the' before dosage schedule or time between doses, or the space before '6 months' or '2 weeks'.

modes.label: The before dose terms
modes.description: The word 'the' right before dosage schedule or time between dose changes.
modes.example: If the intraocular pressure is maintained at satisfactory levels,<< the>> dosage schedule may be changed to one drop

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space after 'every', 'of' or 'for' just before a number of days, weeks or ng/kg/min.
modes.example: Dosage Infusion of epoprostenol for injection should be initiated at 2 ng/kg/min and increased in increments of<< >>2 ng/kg/min every 15

modes.label: Priming or first use
modes.description: Words like 'time' or 'use' in instructions to prime a device before first use.
